rationale: Strict quiet-host precheck passed without override. All six validators cemented 45065 blocks, agreed on final state, and remained in epoch zero. limitations: One strict run compared with the recorded historical baseline; not a statistical noise estimate. The historical baseline used short epochs; Gate A uses a single long epoch. Binary hashes match the previously documented Phase 0 build.
